user.title: DPRemote (Duepi EVO cloud)
user.description: Connect to your stove through Duepi's cloud relay. Enter the same values the MyDPremote app shows under DIRECCIÓN (Address), PUERTA (Port) and CÓDIGO DE DISPOSITIVO (Device code). The device code is the unique code printed on the back of the EVO Remote WiFi module.

data.name: Name
data.host: Address (as shown in the app, e.g. 1.duepiwebserver1.com)
data.port: Port (as shown in the app, e.g. 2000)

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the stove through the cloud relay. Check the address, port and device code, and that the module is online.

abort.already_configured: This device code is already configured.

data.log_to_file: Log every poll to a CSV file (config/dpremote/) for later analysis
data.scan_interval: Poll interval while the stove is ON (seconds)
data.idle_scan_interval: Poll interval while the stove is OFF (seconds)
